_comment: The models each agent runs on, by provider and tier, in the order they are tried. install.sh copies the lists for the chosen provider into every agent's and prompt's `model:` line (see set-models.py). The files in this repo carry the claude lists. Every name gets ' (copilot)' added.

tiers.deep: the ticket chat, log analysis, planning and the security review
tiers.standard: implementation, code and error-handling review, the test router, BLE-protocol and security tests
tiers.fast: log-ticket intake and the other test writers
